verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an official MCP server that users add to their AI assistant via OAuth. The assistant then "acts as you" within your role's permissions, with actions attributed to your account, so the product can be driven by natural-language commands through an external assistant. Fieldwork also advertises "describe your control" with AI agents collecting evidence. The natural-language layer depends on a third-party assistant, and the scope of operable actions is undocumented. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which actions or tools the MCP server exposes, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
